title: GATE-Union source manifest
description: One record per upstream dataset. Written by scripts/fetch_sources.sh and updated by the normalizer. No case enters harmonized/ without a licence verdict.

id.description: injecagent, agentdojo, safeclawbench, toolprivacybench, aspi, agentic_pi_5k, contemporary, gate_original, authored

upstream.description: URL of the official repository, dataset, or paper artefact

pin.description: commit hash, release tag, or dataset revision actually fetched

venue_status.description: peer reviewed venue name, or preprint, or dataset only

redistribution.description: the verdict that decides what may be committed here

gated.description: true if access requires approval, which breaks reviewer rerun

cases_upstream.description: counted from the fetched artefact, never quoted from the paper

family_supply.description: canonical family id to number of cases this source supplies after dedup

layer_supply.description: gate stage to number of cases whose primary layer is that stage
